name: Toy Boy
s: A stripper sets out to prove his innocence for a crime he didn't commit and was unjustly incarcerated for seven years earlier.

paragraphs.text: Toy Boy is a Spanish drama produced by Atresmedia and Plano a Plano. The show stars Jesús Mosquera, Cristina Castaño and María Pedraza. It premiered first on FesTVal and Atresplayer Premium in September 2019 before its premiere on Antena 3 on 25 September 2019.
